payload.name: Material Log
payload.description: What has happened to a job's material at one of its addresses (#675), append-only: the inventory's ledger. Qty is the change to the stock of Material at Address on Job, so an Issued row is negative. A delivery is not a row here: the stock at an address is what the deliveries recorded there hold (Delivery Items."Qty") plus the sum of these rows, computed by lib/materialStock.js and stored nowhere.

fields.name: Material Log ID
fields.description: HYE-ML-YYMMDD-###, minted by lib/idSequence.server.js — a daily family, so the date is the day the row was recorded, not Event Date.

fields.name: Job
fields.description: The job whose stock moved. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: The address whose stock of Material on Job moved. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Material
fields.description: The material whose stock moved. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: What happened: Issued (#675) — the site took it from the address to use. Sent and Received, Send canceled and Written off move it between addresses (#677); Count edited corrects it with a Reason (#678). The screen's words (lib/materialStock.js).

fields.name: Qty
fields.description: The change to the stock of Material at Address on Job, in the material's Unit: negative where stock left the address (Issued), positive where it came in.

fields.name: Event Date
fields.description: The day it happened, as the person recording it gave it — not when it was recorded, which is Recorded At.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why a count was edited (#678). Blank on every other event.

fields.name: Recorded By
fields.description: Who recorded it. One record, enforced by the app.

fields.name: Recorded At
fields.description: When it was recorded, UTC instant, *At convention.
